name: SpeedyBee F405 WING
sources: iNav 9.1.0 (tag e519b69b), target SPEEDYBEEF405WING; paths relative to inav/src/main/

gyro1: target.h:100-104 USE_IMU_ICM42605, ICM42605_CS_PIN PA4, ICM42605_SPI_BUS BUS_SPI1 (SPI1 SCK/MISO/MOSI PA5/PA6/PA7, target.h:35-40); no USE_EXTI: iNav polls the gyro, no INT pin (docs/spike-inav-plane-2026-09-30.md A1)
i2c1: target.h:91-94 I2C1_SCL PB8, I2C1_SDA PB9; baro drivers on BUS_I2C1 target.h:107-113

uart1..uart6: target.h:57-79 (USART1 PA9/PA10, USART2 PA2/PA3, USART3 PC10/PC11, UART4 PA0/PA1, UART5 PC12/PD2, USART6 PC6/PC7); serial = the iNav serial identifier io/serial.h:94-99 (SERIAL_PORT_USART1 = 0 .. SERIAL_PORT_USART6 = 5), the id the CLI's `serial` command takes (fc/cli.c:833-848 serialFindPortConfiguration)
default serial functions: target/SPEEDYBEEF405WING/config.c:36-38 (USART1 RX_SERIAL, USART3 GPS, USART6 MSP); target.h:137-139 (RX_TYPE_SERIAL, SERIALRX_CRSF on SERIAL_PORT_USART1)
output1..output11: target/SPEEDYBEEF405WING/target.c:25-37, 11 x TIM_USE_OUTPUT_AUTO with the comments S1..S11 (labels); target.h:171 MAX_PWM_OUTPUT_PORTS 11
osd1: target.h:124-127 USE_MAX7456, MAX7456_CS_PIN PB12, MAX7456_SPI_BUS BUS_SPI2 (SPI2 PB13/PC2/PC3, target.h:42-46)
sdcard1: target.h:129-135 USE_SDCARD_SPI, SDCARD_SPI_BUS BUS_SPI3, SDCARD_CS_PIN PC14 (SPI3 PB3/PB4/PB5, target.h:48-52)

batt1: target.h:141-150 ADC1 (ADC1_DMA_STREAM DMA2_Stream0), ADC_CHANNEL_1_PIN PC0 = VBAT_ADC_CHANNEL, ADC_CHANNEL_2_PIN PC1 = CURRENT_METER_ADC_CHANNEL; no VBAT_SCALE_DEFAULT (iNav's 1100, sensors/battery.h:29: an 11:1 divider), CURRENT_METER_SCALE 195 (target.h:160: 19.5 mV/A), offset 0; the pads are the board's battery input (VBAT) and its current sensor

onboard parts: the gyro is an ICM-42688-P (target.h:100 comment 'ICM42605/ICM42688P'; iNav drives it with its ICM42605-family driver, drivers/accgyro/accgyro_icm42605.c); the baro is an SPL06-001 (retailer spec, docs/spike-inav-plane-2026-09-30.md A1); MAX7456 and the SD card slot from target.h:124-135
labels: only S1..S11 (target.c comments); UART pad labels printed on the board are not sourced here, left null

pads.note: no INT pin: iNav has no USE_EXTI on this target and polls the gyro
the target's MSP port: the core's MSP/CLI host socket

pads.label: BAT
pads.note: the battery input: VBAT through the 11:1 divider on ADC1 IN10, the current sensor (19.5 mV/A) on IN11

pads.label: USB VCP
pads.note: USB VCP (MSP/CLI on the real board); not emulated, MSP/CLI go over USART6 (the target's default MSP port)

unmapped.label: PINIO1
unmapped.note: user switch output, PINIO box USER1 (target.h:173-175, config.c:40)

unmapped.label: LED0/LED1
unmapped.note: status LEDs blue/green on the SWD pins (target.h:24-25)
